references.geographic_scope: Bjørnøya hydrographic section in the source’s broad high-latitude NwASC continuation. No point longitude or exact core-axis position assigned.
references.temporal_scope: 1993–2022 hydrographic/altimetry mean;53 unevenly sampled Bjørnøya transects, with seasonal bias. Static mean mask, not an instantaneous or quarterly depth series.
references.source_definition: Approximate maximum depth of the Atlantic-Water core selected by descending absolute geostrophic velocity until50% of section mean transport is represented.
references.source_citation: Baumann et al.(2026), Reduced cooling in the Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current, Ocean Science22:17–29, doi:10.5194/os-22-17-2026.
references.source_locator: Section2.1.2 final spatial-extent paragraph and original Figure3d, printed21/PDF5; Section2.1 sampling; Section2.3 source core areas.
references.qualification: Maximum static mask depth is not a full-current bottom or uniform thickness.50m is an imposed surface exclusion. Do not inherit Svinøy1500m or Gimsøy2500m lateral cutoff at Bjørnøya; no numerical Bjørnøya isobath cutoff is established. Source mean-mask cell areas slightly overestimate geometric area by ignoring topographic cell cuts. Quarterly interpolation oversamples the sparse section and supplies no seasonal mask-depth data. Source broad NwASC geography may overlap names used for West Spitsbergen flow; no independent duplicate component volume or identity inheritance. BSO uses a different salinity ranking and remains excluded from velocity-ranked core pairing.
references.source_area_geometry: Rectangular midpoint cells of static mean transport-selected core; topographic partial-cell cuts are not resolved.
references.source_lateral_cutoff_policy: No numerical SI/GI isobath cutoff inherited at Bjornoya
